deviations.description: Rule D is not implemented: a missing structure only nudges the A/B/C detectors slightly. When missing = 1 and no other rule applies, and the request is not close to another rule's threshold (for example, cap at least about 4 Gy above cov), the network sends the request to automated planning instead of escalating.
deviations.condition: (missing == 1) and (cov <= cap - 4) and (cord_lim >= cord_floor + 4) and not ((mand_in_ptv - 0.05 * ptv_vol > 0.1) and (cov > mand_lim))
